q: A subcritical Hopf bifurcation differs from a supercritical one in that:
opts: The limit cycle exists after the bifurcation point
An unstable limit cycle shrinks to the equilibrium as the parameter reaches the critical value
The equilibrium remains stable after bifurcation
The bifurcation involves a zero eigenvalue
exp: Subcritical Hopf: an unstable limit cycle exists before bifurcation and shrinks onto the equilibrium at the critical parameter. After bifurcation, no small limit cycle exists—the system can jump to a distant attractor.
